text:
Sam: Hypothetical emergency poll: there's a tiny (totally fictional) office fire and you can only snag one editor on your way out. Which do you rescue? React with a number or drop a quick reply. :fire:
Alex: :one: VS Code 1 — settings sync and all my extensions are non-negotiable. :sweat_smile:
Maria: :two: Neovim. Dotfiles + muscle memory. Pocket-sized. :star_struck:
Irene: :three: Emacs. It's not just an editor, it's a lifestyle. :nerd_face:
Sam: Poll options (react with emoji):
  :one: VS Code
  :two: Neovim
  :three: Emacs
  :four: Sublime
  :five: Nano
Alex: Reacted :one: — gotta save Live Share sessions.
Maria: Reacted :two: — my config is priceless.
Irene: Reacted :three: — would have also tried to carry a Lisp manual. :books:
deploy-bot: Heads up: evacuation drill at 4pm today. Please only pretend to rescue editors. :robot_face:
Sam: Any surprising honorable mentions?
Alex: JetBrains for when I'm feeling bougie.
Maria: Atom (nostalgia).
Irene: pico for true minimalists.
Sam: Quick tally from reactions: VS Code 2, Neovim 1, Emacs 1. VS Code squeaks ahead.
Maria: We should run a formal emoji poll later 1 — maybe "snack to stock in the kitchen" next. :popcorn:
Alex: Promise there will be snacks as reward for participating. :tada:
